Metadata.title: Gize Admin
Metadata.description: Internal portal for the Gize Transport operations team.

ProblemAlert.title: Something went wrong
ProblemAlert.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the reference and copy it yourself.
ProblemAlert.rateLimited: Too many requests – try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

DevComponents.title: Components
DevComponents.description: Every shared component with the brand tokens. Only available in development and test builds.
DevComponents.emptyDescription: Try another route type, or create a route for this corridor.
DevComponents.problemMessage: This route is full. Record a route request for the rider instead.
DevComponents.problemRateLimited: You've made a lot of requests in a short time.
DevComponents.confirmDescription: The 12 riders reserved for December become active riders from 1 December, and the route starts running.
DevComponents.noRouteSelected: No route selected. Click a row to open it.

Errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.CORS_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED: The portal isn't allowed to reach the API from this address. Contact support.
Errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an admin if you need it.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: This record no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
Errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't available. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This is too much to send at once. Shorten the text and try again.
Errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
Errors.INVALID_CURSOR: This page of results has expired. Go back to the first page.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request was missing a safety key. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH: This action changed while it was being sent. Close the form and start again.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is still being processed. Wait a moment, then check the result.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
Errors.STAFF_EMAIL_TAKEN: Someone on the staff list already uses this email.
Errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This email already has a sign-in account outside the staff list. Contact support.
Errors.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain. Make someone else an admin first.
Errors.AREA_NAME_TAKEN: An area with this name already exists.
Errors.AREA_IN_USE: This area is still used by a corridor, a route or an open route request.
Errors.CORRIDOR_EXISTS: A corridor between these two areas already exists.
Errors.COMPANY_NAME_TAKEN: A company with this name already exists.
Errors.ROUTE_CODE_TAKEN: Another route already uses this code.
Errors.SEATS_BELOW_TAKEN: Seats can't be fewer than the seats already taken on this route.
Errors.SEATS_BELOW_LAUNCH_MINIMUM: Seats can't be fewer than the route's launch minimum.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_RIDERS: Riders are reserved or riding on this route, so this change isn't allowed.
Errors.CORRIDOR_IN_USE: A route uses this corridor, so it can't be changed or deleted.
Errors.COMPANY_IN_USE: This company has routes that block this change.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_NO_PRICES: Company routes don't have prices: the rate is agreed with the company.
Errors.ROUTE_NOT_READY: This route isn't ready for this change yet. Reload it to see what it still needs.
Errors.NOT_ENOUGH_RIDERS: Not enough riders are reserved to launch on this date.
Errors.INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE: This status change isn't possible from the route's current status. Reload it to see what's allowed.
Errors.ROUTE_REQUEST_EXISTS: This person already has an open request for the same thing.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_REQUESTS: Open route requests name this route, so this change isn't allowed.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_PRICES: This route has prices, so its corridor and school can't change. Add a new route instead.
Errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support with the reference.
Errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.

ValidationReasons.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
ValidationReasons.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type.
ValidationReasons.invalid_format: This isn't in the expected format.

Problems.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Problems.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support with the reference.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.description: Gize Admin, for the Gize Transport operations team.
SignIn.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@gizetransport.com.
SignIn.help: No account yet, or forgot your password? Ask a Gize admin.

reasons.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
reasons.not_confirmed: This account isn't confirmed yet. Open the link in your invitation email first.
reasons.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reasons.network: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
reasons.unavailable: The sign-in service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.
reasons.unknown: Signing in didn't work. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.
reasons.not_staff: This account isn't on the Gize staff list, or it has been deactivated. Ask an admin for access.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: The admin portal is being set up. Routes, companies, route requests, riders and drivers will appear here.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved. Check the address, or go back to the overview.

NoPermission.title: No permission
NoPermission.description: Your role can't open this. If you need it for your work, ask a Gize admin.

Areas.title: Areas
Areas.description: Neighbourhoods and landmarks. Corridors, routes and route requests choose from this list.
Areas.emptyDescription: Add the neighbourhoods and landmarks Gize serves. Corridors are made from them.
Areas.noMatchesDescription: Check the spelling, or add the area.
Areas.nameHint: As people say it, in English or Amharic. Up to 100 characters.
Areas.deleteDescription: It disappears from the list and can't be picked any more. Its name can be used again later.
Areas.inUse: A corridor, a route or an open route request uses this area, so it can't be deleted. Change those first.

Corridors.title: Corridors
Corridors.description: Where routes run: from an origin area to a destination area. The way back is its own corridor.
Corridors.emptyDescription: Add the first corridor: where a route starts and where it goes.
Corridors.noMatchesDescription: Try other areas, or add the corridor.
Corridors.formHint: Routes run from the origin to the destination. For the way back, add the reverse corridor too.
Corridors.sameArea: Choose a different area from the origin.
Corridors.exists: A corridor from {origin} to {destination} already exists.
Corridors.inUseEdit: A route runs on this corridor, so its areas can't change. Move the routes to another corridor first, or add a new corridor.
Corridors.deleteDescription: It disappears from the list and can't be picked any more. The same areas can make a corridor again later.
Corridors.inUseDelete: A route runs on this corridor, so it can't be deleted. Move the routes to another corridor first.

Companies.title: Companies
Companies.description: Companies with their own routes. They're billed after the month (postpaid), at the rate agreed with them.
Companies.emptyDescription: Add a company to give it its own corporate routes.
Companies.noMatchesDescription: Check the spelling or the status filter, or add the company.
Companies.billingPostpaid: Postpaid: billed after the month, at the rate agreed with the company
Companies.noRoutes: No routes yet. A corporate route for this company is added from Routes.
Companies.moreRoutes: Showing the first {count} routes. Find the others in Routes.
Companies.deactivateDescription: It can't be chosen for new corporate routes, and its draft routes can't start. Its routes and history stay. You can reactivate it later.
Companies.inUseDeactivate: One of its routes is active or paused, so it can't be deactivated. End those routes first.
Companies.deleteDescription: It disappears from the list and can't be chosen any more. Its name can be used again later. To stop working with a company for now, deactivate it instead.
Companies.inUseDelete: It has routes, so it can't be deleted. Delete or move its routes first, or deactivate the company instead.
Companies.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to find another company.
Companies.formHint: Billed postpaid, at the rate agreed with the company. Contact details are only shown to Gize staff.
Companies.phoneInvalid: Enter an Ethiopian mobile number (09… or 07…).
Companies.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like name@company.com.

Routes.title: Routes
Routes.description: Where vans run, when, and how full they are this month and next.
Routes.emptyDescription: Add the first route: its corridor, type, times and seats. It starts as a draft.
Routes.noMatchesDescription: Try other filters, or add the route.
Routes.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to find another route.
Routes.areasServedNone: Only {origin} and {destination}: no areas in between yet.
Routes.areasHint: The areas the route passes between {origin} and {destination}, in order: riders board or get off in them. No times: the route runs from {origin} to {destination}.
Routes.areaIsOrigin: {name} is where the route starts, so it's always served.
Routes.areaIsDestination: {name} is where the route ends, so it's always served.
Routes.areasFull: A route can serve at most 20 areas between its origin and destination.
Routes.areasTooMany: A route can serve at most 20 areas between its origin and destination.
Routes.areasRefused: This list wasn't accepted: each area once, not the origin or destination, and only areas that still exist. The route may have changed meanwhile: close this, and it reloads as it is now.
Routes.pricesHint: Whole birr a month. The route needs a round-trip and a one-way price before it can start forming.
Routes.pricesFrozenNote: Once a route has prices, its corridor and school can't change: to serve somewhere else, add a new route.
Routes.saturdayHint: Leave empty for no Saturday add-on.
Routes.noPricesForCorporate: Corporate routes have no prices: they're billed at the rate agreed with the company.
Routes.formHint: A new route starts as a draft. Prices, areas served and status are set on the route afterwards.
Routes.codeHint: 2–20 letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. BOLE-MEX-01. Saved in capitals.
Routes.typeFixed: The type can't change after the route is added.
Routes.timesHint: Each time after the one before.
Routes.launchMinimumHint: Riders reserved before the route can launch: 1 up to the seats.
Routes.codeInvalid: Use 2–20 letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
Routes.corridorRequired: Choose an origin and a destination area that have a corridor between them.
Routes.timesOrder: This must be later than the time before it.
Routes.arrivalsTogether: Set both arrival times, or neither.
Routes.seatsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.
Routes.launchMinimumInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.
Routes.launchMinimumAboveSeats: The launch minimum can't be more than the seats.
Routes.codeTaken: Another route already has this code.
Routes.seatsBelowTaken: More seats than this are already taken on some day. Keep at least that many.
Routes.seatsBelowLaunchMinimum: The seats can't be fewer than the launch minimum.
Routes.hasRiders: Riders hold seats on this route, so its corridor, school or company can't change.
Routes.hasPrices: This route has prices, so its corridor and school are fixed. To serve somewhere else, add a new route.
Routes.hasRequests: Open route requests name this route, so its corridor and school are fixed. To serve somewhere else, add a new route.
Routes.corridorHasAreas: This route serves areas between its origin and destination. Clear its areas served before changing the corridor.
Routes.timesOrderAlert: Check the times: each must be later than the one before.
Routes.blockedPrices: An admin must set the round-trip and one-way prices.
Routes.blockedCompany: The company isn't active: reactivate it first.
Routes.blockedRiders: Someone is reserved or riding, so it can't go back to draft.
Routes.confirmStartFormingDescription: It takes reservations until enough riders reach the launch minimum ({minimum}). It can go back to draft while nobody is reserved.
Routes.confirmBackToDraftDescription: It stops taking reservations. It can start forming again later.
Routes.confirmStartServiceDescription: The route runs for {company} from now, and its riders can be added.
Routes.confirmPauseDescription: Riders keep their places; the van doesn't run until the route is resumed.
Routes.confirmResumeDescription: The van runs again for its riders.
Routes.refuseNotReady: The route isn't ready for this any more (prices missing, or its company isn't active). It has been reloaded.
Routes.refuseNotEnough: Fewer riders are reserved for that month than the launch minimum now. The route has been reloaded.
Routes.refuseHasRiders: Someone is reserved now, so it can't go back to draft. The route has been reloaded.
Routes.refuseInvalid: This move isn't possible from the route's status any more. The route has been reloaded.
Routes.launchHint: Choose the month its riders start. Only months with enough riders reserved can be chosen.
Routes.launchNoReadyMonth: No month has enough riders reserved yet.
Routes.launchDateRefused: That month can't be chosen any more. The months have been reloaded.
Routes.deleteDescription: It disappears from the list and its code can be used again. Its history stays.
Routes.deleteHasRiders: Someone is reserved or riding on this route, so it can't be deleted.
Routes.deleteHasRequests: An open route request names this route, so it can't be deleted. Decline or fulfil the request first.
Routes.launchStarts: The route becomes active now; its reserved riders start on {date}.
Routes.launchChosenGone: {month} isn't ready any more: choose another month.
Routes.vanHint: A new route like {code}, for when it's full. It gets its own code and seats; it copies the rest:
Routes.vanCopiesCorridor: the corridor ({origin} → {destination}) and the four times
Routes.vanCompanyInactive: The company isn't active, so its route can't get another van. Reactivate the company first.

RouteRequests.title: Route requests
RouteRequests.description: People waiting for a route between their areas, or for a seat on a full one. Oldest first: the order free seats are offered in.
RouteRequests.unknownRoute: That route no longer exists, so no request matches.
RouteRequests.routeUnavailable: The route couldn't be loaded; the list still shows its requests.
RouteRequests.emptyDescription: Record a request when someone calls for a route that doesn't exist yet, or for a seat on a full one.
RouteRequests.noMatchesDescription: Try other filters, or clear them.
RouteRequests.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to find another request.
RouteRequests.nextStepsNew: Match it to the route this person will ride, or mark it fulfilled once they have a place.
RouteRequests.nextStepsMatched: Mark it fulfilled once this person has a place on {code}.
RouteRequests.closedFulfilled: Fulfilled: this person has a place. Nothing more to do.
RouteRequests.closedDeclined: Declined. If they ask again, record a new request.
RouteRequests.matchDescription: The route this person will get a place on. Adults need a public route; students a student route of their school. It may still be being set up, like a van just added.
RouteRequests.matchRouteNotFor: This route isn't for this rider: adults need a public route, students a student route of their school.
RouteRequests.fulfilDescription: Do this once the person has a place on a route. A fulfilled request is closed for good.
RouteRequests.declineDescription: Say why, for whoever reads it later. A declined request is closed for good; if the person asks again, record a new one.
RouteRequests.declineReasonHint: Up to 100 characters, e.g. Too far from our corridors for now.
RouteRequests.statusChangeInvalid: This request changed meanwhile, so that isn't possible any more. It has been reloaded to show where it is now.
RouteRequests.deleteDescription: For a request recorded by mistake: it disappears from the list and from the demand counts. To say no to someone, decline the request instead.
RouteRequests.formHint: From a phone call. Contact details are only shown to Gize staff.
RouteRequests.editHint: Who and when. What was asked for can't change: decline this request and record a new one instead.
RouteRequests.kindNewAreasOption: A route between two areas no route serves yet
RouteRequests.kindRouteOption: A seat on a specific route (usually a full one)
RouteRequests.endNameHint: As the caller says it, e.g. Lebu.
RouteRequests.endRequired: Choose an area, or type the name of one not listed yet.
RouteRequests.endsSame: From and to must be different areas.
RouteRequests.routeHintStudent: A running student route; the student's school is the route's.
RouteRequests.routeNotFor: This route isn't running, or isn't for this rider: adults need a public route, students a student route of their school.
RouteRequests.schoolRouteWait: Wait until the route's school shows, then record the request.
RouteRequests.schoolTooLong: Keep the school's name to 100 characters.
RouteRequests.schoolNotRoute: It must stay the school of the route this request names.
RouteRequests.timesOrder: The return time comes after the morning time.
RouteRequests.timeCantClear: A time can be changed here, not removed.
RouteRequests.contactNameHint: Who to call. For a student, a parent or guardian.
RouteRequests.phoneInvalid: Enter an Ethiopian mobile number, e.g. 0911 23 45 67.
RouteRequests.existsAreas: This person already has an open request for these areas.
RouteRequests.existsRoute: This person already has an open request for {code}.
RouteRequests.existsEdit: With this change it would be the same as another open request from this person.

AreaPicker.moreHint: Only the first matches are shown. Type more of the name to find others.

CompanyPicker.noResults: No active companies start with that.
CompanyPicker.moreHint: Only the first matches are shown. Type more of the name to find others.
